name: Abanca
verdict: A private Galician bank whose principal shareholder is banker Juan Carlos Escotet Rodriguez. Nothing found.
note: Rating note: Private bank (Abanca Corporacion Bancaria, S.A.); Banesco Internacional says its founder Juan Carlos Escotet Rodriguez is also Abanca's principal shareholder. Escotet's exact stake is not stated by the source. No state or fund capital, no serious-abuse record found.
